_doc.about: medal: one shape carries the film (the saas-animation manner, «ميار عثمان», 2026-11-06). A gold medal drops on a red field and grows into the first shot; every later shot grows out of the one before; at end.at the frame shrinks back into the medal. Send the owner a numbered storyboard first and wait for his yes.
_doc.shots[0]: the first shot grows out of the medal at its start (the medal drops and squashes before that: start it at about 2.5 s)
_doc.shots[].move: how the shot arrives: iris (a circle opens from the centre), flip (the frame closes into a card that flips edge-on; flips must end with a flood), flood (the card floods gold and grows to fill the frame)
_doc.shots[].at: the move's time when it should differ from the shot's start (e.g. an iris a little before the cut)
_doc.shots[].fill: iris colour: ink, field or a CSS colour (irises alternate ink / field by default)
_doc.title: the name under the medal at the start (Tajawal 78, word by word)
_doc.lines: one line per shot, lower centre over a soft shade (Tajawal 64)
_doc.end: at = when the frame shrinks back into the medal (0.7 s); title under the medal; credit 1.4 s after the medal lands
_doc.field / ink / medal_text: the field colour (#b5121b), the card colour (#0b0b10) and the medal's figure (١)
